name.zh: 無底板頁首列＋貼齊左上的大標誌方塊、導覽右，捲動後只剩小標誌與選單按鈕
name.en: Bare header bar with a large logo block flush top-left and navigation on the right, reduced to a small logo and menu button after scrolling

name.zh: 無底板頁首列＋標誌左、主要按鈕右，沒有導覽連結
name.en: Bare header bar with logo left and primary button right, no navigation

name.zh: 無底板頁首列＋標誌左、導覽置中，下拉子選單，手機右側抽屜
name.en: Bare header bar with logo left, centered navigation, dropdown submenu and right-side drawer on mobile

name.zh: 無底板頁首列＋標誌左、導覽與按鈕右，往下捲動隱藏
name.en: Bare header bar with logo left, navigation and button right, hides on scroll down

name.zh: 無底板頁首＋標誌左上、選單按鈕右下
name.en: Bare header with logo top-left and menu button bottom-right

name.zh: 整列頁首＋標誌置中、導覽連結在左、功能區在右，下緣分隔線
name.en: Header bar + logo centered, navigation links on the left, actions group on the right, bottom divider

name.zh: 整列頁首（大標誌置中、超出下緣）→ 捲動後縮成標誌靠左的矮頁首，側滑選單
name.en: Full-width header (large centered logo overflowing its bottom edge) → shrinks to a shorter header with the logo on the left after scrolling, slide-in menu

name.zh: 整列頁首＋標誌左、導覽置中、功能區右，下緣分隔線，手機側邊抽屜選單
name.en: Full-width header bar + logo left, navigation centered, actions right, bottom divider, mobile side drawer menu

name.zh: 整列頁首＋標誌左、導覽與功能區右，上下分隔線，往下捲動隱藏
name.en: Header bar with logo left, navigation and actions right, dividers, hides on scroll down

name.zh: 整列頁首＋標誌左、導覽右，滑過展開子連結，捲動後出現底板
name.en: Full-width header bar + logo left, navigation right, hover dropdown, gains a background panel after scrolling

name.zh: 整列頁首＋標誌左、導覽與輸入框和圖示按鈕靠右，手機改底部分頁列
name.en: Full-width header bar + logo left, navigation, input and icon buttons on the right, bottom tab bar on mobile

name.zh: 整列頁首＋標誌左、兩列導覽靠右、貼邊主要按鈕，捲動後變矮並只留導覽
name.en: Header bar with logo left, two-row navigation on the right and a flush primary button; shrinks to navigation only on scroll

name.zh: 整列頁首（不固定）＋標誌左、導覽與功能區右，滑過展開大型面板
name.en: Non-fixed header bar with logo left, navigation and actions right, mega panel on hover

name.zh: 無底板浮動頁首（標誌＋選單按鈕）→ 捲動後右側出現導覽容器
name.en: Floating header with no backing (logo + menu button) → navigation container appears on the right after scrolling

name.zh: 置中浮動頁首（四角圓角）＋標誌左、導覽置中、選單按鈕右，選單往下延伸成大面板
name.en: Centered floating header (all corners rounded) + logo left, navigation centered, menu button right, menu expands into a large panel
